_setup: Optional: set topGunRecord to Dynasty Bruh's all-time single-week high.
At 0, Top Gun treats any score as a record. Delete this block whenever.

games.name: The Long Game
games.weeks: Nominate by kickoff → Jan 3 · Incl. playoffs
games.blurb: Nominate one player before kickoff. Biggest KTC gain by championship day wins.
games.desc: Dynasty isn't won in a week. Nominate one player before the first game of the season kicks off — whoever's pick climbs the most in KTC Superflex value between then and championship day wins. Opening-night conviction, graded in January.
games.highlight: Nominations close before the first kickoff. Your starting value is whatever KTC says on the day you submit.
games.emptyHint: Commissioner adds player nominations and weekly KTC Superflex values to the Google Sheet.
rules: Nominate one player from your roster before the deadline
Values come from KeepTradeCut's dynasty rankings, with the Superflex toggle set to match your league
Your starting value is his value on the day you submit — the site records the time
He has to stay on your roster through Week 17
Biggest gain from your starting value to championship day wins
If two managers tie, the higher final value wins

submission.label: Nominate your Long Game player
submission.help: Any player on your roster right now. Pick the one you think climbs the most in KTC Superflex value by January.
submission.linkNote: KTC defaults to Superflex. Make sure the Superflex toggle at the top matches your league before you read values — 1QB values are very different, especially for quarterbacks.

games.name: The Tactician
games.blurb: Actual points vs. your perfect lineup. Highest season average wins.
games.desc: Anyone can win with the right players. The Tactician wins with the right decisions. Tracks how close you get to your perfect lineup every week — actual points scored vs. maximum possible across the full regular season. Genius is in the details.
games.highlight: Efficiency is actual divided by best possible, carried to two decimals. Highest season average wins.
games.emptyHint: Commissioner enters actual vs. max points each week in the Google Sheet.
rules: Each week your efficiency is the points you scored divided by the most you could have scored
The most you could have scored is the best legal lineup available from your roster that week
Highest average across Weeks 1 to 14 wins, carried to two decimal places
A week counts once the commissioner has posted both numbers
If two managers tie, the better single week wins; still tied, compare next-best weeks until someone is ahead

games.name: The Sleeper
games.weeks: Acquire W1–4 · Baseline W1–4 · Perf W5–14
games.blurb: Pick up a guy in W1–4. Biggest jump over his early-season baseline wins.
games.desc: Every league has a guy who saw it coming. Acquire a player in Weeks 1–4 and declare your pick before W5 — the manager whose player shows the biggest average score improvement from their W1–4 baseline to their W5–14 performance wins. Check the wire, work the trade block, get off the bench and make a move.
games.highlight: Baseline is his real Weeks 1 to 4 average, whoever owned him. Performance is Weeks 5 to 14 with the worst week dropped.
games.emptyHint: Declare your pick before Week 5 locks — the table fills in as the season runs.
rules: Pick up a player in Weeks 1 to 4, then declare him between the Tuesday after Week 4 and Thursday kickoff
He must have played at least two of those four weeks, and be on your roster when you declare
His baseline is his average score over the games he played in Weeks 1 to 4, no matter who owned him
Weeks he was inactive or on bye are left out of that average, not counted as zero
His performance is his Weeks 5 to 14 average with his worst week dropped
Biggest jump from baseline to performance wins, and you have to still own him at the end of Week 14
If two managers tie on the jump, the one whose player scored more from Week 5 on wins

submission.label: Declare your Sleeper pick
submission.help: Only players you added in Weeks 1 to 4 who are still on your roster. The window opens once Week 4 is final and closes before Thursday kickoff.
submission.openNote: Week 4 has to finish before we know who's eligible — only players you added in Weeks 1 to 4 and still own can be declared.

games.name: Cardiac King
games.blurb: Closest margins in W1–4, win or lose. Your biggest blowout gets dropped.
games.desc: Blowouts are boring. Cardiac King goes to whoever spends September sweating — the manager whose Weeks 1–4 matchups land on the thinnest margins, win or lose. Your ugliest week gets thrown out, so one blowout won't cost you it. Close only counts in horseshoes, hand grenades, and this.
games.highlight: Margin is absolute — a 2-point win and a 2-point loss score the same. Your worst week is dropped.
games.emptyHint: Fills in automatically from Sleeper once Week 1 scores post.
rules: Your margin each week is how close the game was, win or lose
Across Weeks 1 to 4, your biggest blowout is thrown out
Lowest average of the other three weeks wins
If two managers tie, the lowest total across all four weeks wins

games.name: Not Dead Yet
games.blurb: Biggest week-over-week scoring jump in the home stretch.
games.desc: You had a bad week. It was one week. The biggest single week-over-week scoring jump across Weeks 10 through 14 takes it — proof that being buried in November means nothing if you can still put up a number. There's always next week.
games.highlight: Best single jump between back-to-back weeks in Weeks 10 to 14. One good Sunday is all it takes.
games.emptyHint: Fills in automatically from Sleeper once Week 10 scores post.
rules: Compares each week to the one before it, across Weeks 10 to 14
Your biggest single jump is your score — only improvements count
If two managers tie, the higher score in the better week wins

games.name: Turducken Bowl
games.blurb: Four players. One lineup. Three days of Thanksgiving football.
games.desc: Five games across Wednesday, Thursday and Friday of Thanksgiving week — the first three-day slate in NFL history. You'll build one lineup from it. Anybody's players, not just the ones on your roster. Full rules drop closer to the date.
games.highlight: One lineup from the Thanksgiving slate. Everything else is still being worked out.
rules: Four players from the Wednesday to Friday Thanksgiving games
Any player is eligible — he does not have to be on your roster
Everything locks before Wednesday kickoff
Scoring, roster construction and tiebreakers announced closer to the date
